_doc: Persistent self-monitor profile. Survives reboots and chat interruptions. Read by rc_supervisor.py on boot and by rc_self_monitor.py on every tick.
_hot_reload_note: Only SAFE_RELOAD modules. UI modules must rebuild via callbacks, never via importlib.reload on live widgets. RESTART_ONLY modules must stay restart-only.
_panel_rebuild_note: Rebuild triggers a registered callback (rebuild_panel_{key}), never importlib.reload.
_restart_only_note: These modules MUST NOT be hot-reloaded. They own live tkinter widgets, threads, or per-game mutable state.
